title: Warm and calm
summary: Gentle, welcoming images with an unhurried feel.
look: soft warm light, natural texture, gentle contrast
pace: slow, steady cuts with room to breathe
music_hint: quiet piano or soft acoustic tones

title: Fast and punchy
summary: Bright energy, crisp movement and quick changes.
look: clear light, bold natural colors, crisp detail
pace: quick cuts that follow the action
music_hint: upbeat percussion and a lively pulse
caption_style: short bold captions timed to the beat

title: Dreamy
summary: Airy images and flowing movement for a reflective mood.
look: soft highlights, gentle haze, muted colors
pace: flowing shots with occasional slow pauses
music_hint: light ambient tones or delicate strings

title: Clean and bright
summary: Open, clear images with an even pace and fresh feel.
look: bright natural light, clean whites, balanced color
pace: even cuts with clear visual steps
music_hint: light instrumental music with a steady pulse
caption_style: clear high contrast captions with consistent placement
